'''Pettyr Zent''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[operative]] assigned to the [[ByblosNova]] cell on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]]. Zent was contacted by [[Hamiz Spel]] of the [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis branch]] regarding [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] activity.<ref name="ISB" />
